structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems

law.catch_line: Commission a responsible public entity under Public-Private Transportation Act of 1995
law.text: The Commission is a responsible public entity as defined in § 33.2-1800 and shall be regulated in accordance with the terms of the Public-Private Transportation Act of 1995 (§ 33.2-1800 et seq.) and regulations and guidelines adopted pursuant thereto.
